data_scenarios.data_condition: No records exist or the active filters match nothing.
data_scenarios.expectation: Explain the empty condition, preserve active filters, and expose the next useful action.

data_scenarios.data_condition: Representative and maximum-density records are available.
data_scenarios.expectation: Preserve hierarchy, action availability, and scanability without layout shift.

data_scenarios.data_condition: Some records are stale, still loading, or unavailable.
data_scenarios.expectation: Distinguish usable from pending content and preserve retry, selection, and scroll context.

data_scenarios.data_condition: A request fails, permission is limited, or the client is offline.
data_scenarios.expectation: Keep confirmed data and unsaved input, explain the cause, and expose safe retry or recovery.

content_constraints: Support labels and actions at 200% text zoom without truncation.
Keep table cells, validation, and recovery copy understandable with long localized values.
component_contracts.iconography: Use the product icon set with text labels for unfamiliar, destructive, permission, and recovery actions; never rely on shape or color alone.

responsive_matrix.label: compact web
responsive_matrix.adaptation: Navigation condenses, the primary task stays first, and controls remain operable without horizontal scrolling.
responsive_matrix.stretch_behavior: Reflow continuously to the supported minimum while preserving focus, selection, scroll position, and unsaved input.
responsive_matrix.overflow_behavior: Wrap or internally scroll bounded content; never clip primary actions or introduce page-level horizontal scrolling.

responsive_matrix.label: regular web
responsive_matrix.adaptation: Navigation, content, and secondary context share the viewport without changing task priority.
responsive_matrix.stretch_behavior: Redistribute columns between compact and wide thresholds without resetting active interaction state.
responsive_matrix.overflow_behavior: Keep long text, dense tables, menus, and dialogs operable through bounded wrapping or scrolling.

responsive_matrix.label: wide web
responsive_matrix.adaptation: Additional width improves scanability and context rather than stretching the reading measure.
responsive_matrix.stretch_behavior: Cap reading measure and use surplus width for approved context without diluting task hierarchy.
responsive_matrix.overflow_behavior: Constrain panes and collections independently so dense content cannot push primary controls off screen.

interaction_matrix.trigger: Click, double activation, hover, drag, or context-menu invocation on an enabled target.
interaction_matrix.event_sequence: Resolve pointerdown, any pointermove beyond the drag threshold, and pointerup/click as one gesture; treat pointercancel, capture loss, or release outside the valid target as cancellation.
interaction_matrix.immediate_feedback: Show pressed, selected, drag-preview, drop-target, or context-menu feedback within the immediate response budget without implying completion.
interaction_matrix.focus_behavior: Move focus only when the native control or documented composite pattern requires it; preserve visible focus, selection, scroll anchor, and the invoking target across transient layers.
interaction_matrix.repeat_behavior: Distinguish single, double, held, and repeated activation; debounce or reject duplicate consequential actions while preserving legitimate repeated controls.
interaction_matrix.cancellation_behavior: Pointercancel, Escape during a captured gesture, invalid drop, or release outside restores the last committed state and removes transient feedback.
interaction_matrix.pending_behavior: While work is pending, keep status and cancel/retry affordances perceivable, block only conflicting activation, and never convert a pending press into duplicate submission.

interaction_matrix.surface: Web application controls, navigation, dialogs, and collections
interaction_matrix.trigger: Tab or arrow navigation followed by Enter, Space, Escape, or the documented shortcut.
interaction_matrix.event_sequence: Resolve keydown and keyup according to the native control pattern, synthesize one activation, and reserve Tab, arrows, Escape, Enter, and Space for the focused context without browser-shortcut conflict.
interaction_matrix.immediate_feedback: Expose visible focus before activation and show pressed, expanded, selected, pending, or validation feedback without waiting for key release when the platform pattern requires an immediate response.
interaction_matrix.focus_behavior: Keep focus visible and ordered, contain modal focus, restore the invoker after dismissal, and preserve the active descendant and scroll position through rerenders.
interaction_matrix.repeat_behavior: Ignore operating-system key repeat for single-submit actions while allowing documented repeat for navigation, stepping, scrolling, or continuous controls.
interaction_matrix.cancellation_behavior: Escape or the documented cancel command closes only the top cancellable context, restores focus, and leaves committed state unchanged; keyboard traps are forbidden.
interaction_matrix.pending_behavior: Announce pending state once, retain a stable focus target, suppress conflicting shortcuts or duplicate activation, and expose safe cancellation or retry when available.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: No records exist or active filters match nothing.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Distinguish first-use from no-results, preserve filters, and offer the next useful create, import, or reset action.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Representative and maximum-density records, long values, and mixed statuses are present.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Keep hierarchy, action availability, selection, and scanability stable without layout shift or silent truncation.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Cached records remain usable while pages, mutations, or dependent regions are loading or stale.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Mark freshness and pending regions locally, retain usable content and input, and prevent out-of-order responses from overwriting newer state.

data_state_matrix.data_condition: Network, permission, session, validation, or server failure blocks the requested result.
data_state_matrix.expectation: Explain the bounded cause, preserve confirmed data and unsaved input, place errors near the affected control or region, and expose a safe recovery path.

accessibility_matrix.reading_order: DOM reading order follows the visible task hierarchy before responsive visual rearrangement.
accessibility_matrix.focus_order: Focus follows task order, enters contained overlays deliberately, and returns to the invoking control after dismissal.
keyboard: Complete every primary task without a pointer.
Use standard Tab, arrow, Enter, Space, and Escape behavior without keyboard traps.
announcements: Announce validation at the affected field.
Announce loading completion, errors, and asynchronous collection changes without stealing focus.
accessibility_matrix.target_size: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA target-size requirements, using at least 24x24 CSS px or documented spacing exceptions.
accessibility_matrix.contrast: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in light, dark, high-contrast, hover, focus, disabled, and error combinations.
accessibility_matrix.zoom_reflow: Reflow at 400% zoom and 200% text size without two-dimensional page scrolling, loss of content, or hidden controls.
alternatives: Provide text equivalents for icons and meaningful images.
Provide non-drag and non-color alternatives for every action and status.

navigation_matrix.entry: Application URL, navigation item, notification link, or preserved browser history entry.
navigation_matrix.destination: The named route, selected record, state, or task step with required context restored.
navigation_matrix.trigger: Pointer or keyboard activation, browser back/forward, or a validated deep link.
navigation_matrix.back_behavior: Return to the prior meaningful route and restore filters, selection, scroll position, and safe draft state.
navigation_matrix.deep_link_behavior: Open the intended authorized object or state directly; otherwise show a bounded missing, expired, or permission outcome without leaking data.
navigation_matrix.interruption_recovery: After refresh, session renewal, connectivity loss, or external update, restore the last safe checkpoint and reconcile stale actions explicitly.

content_matrix.purpose: Help the user understand context and complete one primary job.
content_matrix.copy: Use concrete labels and verbs that match the user's domain; keep supporting text scannable and place prerequisites before action.
content_matrix.primary_action: Name the outcome rather than the gesture and keep one dominant action per task region.
content_matrix.trust_requirement: Show consequence, scope, ownership, freshness, and irreversible effects before commitment.
content_matrix.localization: Support right-to-left layout, locale-aware dates, numbers, names, and at least 30% text expansion without semantic truncation.
content_limits: Keep button labels concise but never replace meaning with an unlabeled icon.
Wrap long names and identifiers or expose their full value on focus without obscuring controls.

content_matrix.surface: Web empty, error, permission, and destructive states
content_matrix.purpose: Explain what happened, what remains safe, and the next available action.
content_matrix.copy: Use specific, non-blaming language with the failed scope and a useful recovery step.
content_matrix.primary_action: Offer retry, revise, request access, undo, or return only when that action is safe and available.
content_matrix.trust_requirement: Never imply success before confirmation; identify retained data, destructive consequences, and whether retry can duplicate work.
content_matrix.localization: Keep recovery meaning intact under translation, plural rules, right-to-left order, and locale-specific support references.
content_limits: Do not expose secrets, internal stack traces, or inaccessible object names.
Keep the essential cause and recovery action visible before expandable diagnostics.

motion_contract.purpose: web: Use motion to preserve spatial continuity, confirm direct manipulation, and reveal asynchronous state without delaying work.

transitions.surface: Web controls, overlays, collections, and responsive layout
transitions.trigger: Direct activation, overlay entry or exit, collection update, or responsive reflow.
transitions.response: Animate only the affected relationship while feedback and final state remain perceivable without motion.
transitions.interrupt_behavior: A new input cancels or retargets from the current visual state without queuing, focus loss, duplicate action, or stale completion.

motion_contract.reduced_motion: web: Remove spatial travel, parallax, and nonessential stagger; use immediate state changes, opacity, and persistent status text while preserving sequence and feedback.

methods: target-user task session for high-consequence or unfamiliar flows
critical_tasks: Reach the intended route from navigation or a deep link.
Complete and recover the primary data-changing action.
Understand empty, partial, error, and permission outcomes.
success_criteria: Participants complete the primary task without moderator rescue.
No critical accessibility blocker or unrecoverable context loss remains.
Users can state the consequence and recovery path before a high-consequence action.

editing_matrix.surface: Web forms, search, filters, and inline editable controls
editing_matrix.composition_behavior: Preserve the IME composition buffer and do not validate, format, submit, or invoke character shortcuts until composition commits.
editing_matrix.paste_autofill_behavior: Accept paste, browser autofill, password-manager, and dictation updates through native input events; preserve the entered value and expose intentional normalization.
editing_matrix.selection_caret_behavior: Preserve selection, caret, scroll, and text direction through rerenders, suggestions, masking, asynchronous feedback, and focus return.
editing_matrix.formatting_behavior: Parse locale-aware values without rewriting partial input; apply destructive trimming, masking, or canonical formatting only at a documented boundary without moving the caret unexpectedly.
editing_matrix.validation_timing: Do not validate during IME composition; validate at the documented blur, change, or submit boundary and update an already exposed error as soon as the value becomes valid.
editing_matrix.validation_feedback: Associate concise error and correction text with the field, retain the value, expose a summary only when useful, and announce each material change once without color alone.
editing_matrix.dirty_state_behavior: Distinguish unchanged, dirty, saving, saved, and failed values; warn on navigation only when confirmed user input would be lost.
editing_matrix.persistence_behavior: For manual save or autosave, expose ownership and freshness, retain safe drafts across retry, refresh, offline recovery, and session renewal, and never claim unsaved work is saved.
editing_matrix.undo_redo_behavior: Preserve native text undo/redo and provide bounded application undo for committed reversible edits without corrupting selection or newer changes.
editing_matrix.conflict_behavior: Detect stale, multi-tab, or remote edit conflict before overwrite; show the competing version and offer explicit reload, keep, compare, or merge recovery.
editing_matrix.read_only_disabled_behavior: Keep read-only values selectable and understandable, remove disabled controls from activation, and state why an action is disabled and what can enable it.
editing_matrix.submission_behavior: Define Enter and multiline behavior, validate before side effects, prevent duplicate submission while pending, preserve values on failure, and bind success to the authoritative response.
